title: SkillResponse
description: Standardized return value from every skill's execute() method. Skills return responseKey (not spokenText) so the Voice Personality Layer resolves the spoken string from responseVariations.js.

success.description: True if the skill action completed without error.

responseKey.description: Dot-notation key into responseVariations.js. Example: 'camera.startScan.success'. The router resolves this to a natural-language spoken string.

nextState.description: Target voice engine state after execution.

data.description: Additional payload for HUD telemetry or follow-up context updates.

errorCode.description: Optional. VOICE_001–VOICE_005 error code if success is false. Routes to RecoveryManager.
